name: Torso
notes: Core structural part. Houses cockpit and primary systems.

name: Left Arm
notes: Left structural arm. Mounts left-hand weapon.

name: Right Arm
notes: Right structural arm. Mounts right-hand weapon.

name: Legs
notes: Leg assembly. Single unit (not split L/R). Governs mobility and weight capacity.

name: Right Hand Weapon
notes: Primary weapon. All frames have this slot.

name: Left Hand Weapon
notes: Secondary weapon. All frames have this slot.

name: Right Shoulder Weapon
notes: Heavy mount. Medium/Heavy frames only (per frame.equipSlots).

name: Left Shoulder Weapon
notes: Heavy mount. Heavy frames only (per frame.equipSlots).

name: Backpack
notes: Utility slot. Backpack items from parts.json with type=backpack.
